checks.description: PhilCore4337Account.execute remains EntryPoint-only.
PhilCore4337Account.execute restricts target to immutable approvedActionGate.
PhilCore4337Account.execute restricts calldata to the two reviewed ActionGate selectors.
Account-self cannot bypass execution restrictions.
No delegatecall exists in the account/factory path.
No generic batch execution exists in the account/factory path.
No upgrade/proxy entry point exists in the account/factory path.
Recovery authority cannot invoke ordinary execution.
Recovery functions do not change EntryPoint, ActionGate, or ownerCommitment.
Factory and account share exact ActionGate binding.
CREATE2 derivation includes initialization-critical fields.
Paymasters are explicitly rejected and no session-key or aggregator behavior exists.
Base mirror remains messenger-only.
Base mirror validates authorized L1 remote sender.
ActionGate nullifier handling remains atomic with consumer execution.
No raw private-key-shaped constants or test secrets appear in production Solidity source.
Recovery and execution selectors remain separated.
PhilMintPassConsumer cannot retain unauthorized ETH because nonzero msg.value is rejected before mint state changes.
Recovery authority rotation stores exactly one pending authority and only activates it on completion.
Recovery authority rotation cannot change execution owner, EntryPoint, ActionGate, or ownerCommitment.
Recovery authority rotation performs no external calls or value transfers.
Initial recovery authority remains part of factory CREATE2 derivation while post-deployment account rotation preserves address stability.
Beta ordinary ActionGate execution is explicitly zero-value.
Beta account validation rejects every paymaster payload on chain.
Disposable fund release is EntryPoint-only, freeze-aware, and fixed to the current owner.
The account rejects a zero owner commitment during construction.
The reusable factory registers deployed accounts for the composed Sepolia ActionGate.
The local-proof account has one fixed execution function and no generic, batch, delegatecall, or upgrade path.
The local-proof account validates exact calldata, rejects paymasters, and binds version, model, expiry, and validator key.
The local-proof account calls only the immutable confirmation target with no value.
Local-proof CREATE2 derivation binds all public initialization fields without secret material.
The local-proof confirmation target validates account model, target, chain, and exact evidence.
The Sepolia mint account is EntryPoint-only, zero-value, gate-only, and selector-restricted.
Malformed execution signatures fail validation without a reverting recover path.
The Sepolia mint account and factory contain no generic batch, delegatecall, proxy, or upgrade path.
Sepolia mint CREATE2 derivation binds EntryPoint, execution owner, owner commitment, gate, salt, and factory.
The ActionGate enforces chain, registered account, expiry, and atomic three-dimensional replay consumption before mint.
The harmless pass is gate-only, non-transferable, non-payable, and independently replay protected.
The on-chain boundary explicitly disclaims Noir and P-256 verification and contains no alternate verifier or attestation path.
The composed ActionGate admits only its one immutable counterfactual Beta account.
The composed ActionGate mints only to the authorized account's current execution owner.
